map.HEX → RGB：#RRGGBB 每两位十六进制转十进制（#ABC 缩写展开为: HEX → RGB: #RRGGBB converts each two-digit hex pair to decimal (#ABC shorthand expands to #AABBCC)
map.RGB → HEX：各通道四舍五入后转两位十六进制拼接: RGB → HEX: each channel is rounded and converted to two hex digits, then concatenated
map.RGB → HSL：归一化后 L=(max+min)/2，S 按 L 与 (ma: RGB → HSL: after normalization L=(max+min)/2, S is computed piecewise from L and (max−min), and H is the hue angle computed piecewise from the maximum channel
map.HSL → RGB：按色相落在 1/6、1/2、2/3 六个区间的分段插值: HSL → RGB: piecewise interpolation according to which of the six intervals of 1/6, 1/2, and 2/3 the hue falls into
map.RGB → CMYK：K = 1−max(R,G,B)；C=(1−R−K)/(1: RGB → CMYK: K = 1−max(R,G,B); C=(1−R−K)/(1−K), M and Y likewise (pure black when K=1)
map.CMYK → RGB：R = 255×(1−C)×(1−K)，G、B 同理: CMYK → RGB: R = 255×(1−C)×(1−K), G and B likewise
